Riley: Quick copy pass on the Autoscale toggle tooltip and the follow-up confirmation dialog. Current tooltip: `Autoscale: on` and the dialog says 'Are you sure you want to enable autoscale?' Feels terse and unclear about billing/limits. Priya: Yea the tooltip is basically a label, not a helpful hint. Users expect 1-2 words + reason. Suggest: tooltip = 'Autoscale: adjusts instance count to traffic' and secondary line 'May affect monthly spend'. Jon: +1 on clarity. Also for the confirmation modal, we should surface the minimum and maximum limits being applied. Right now modal only says 'Enabled' which is not actionable. Riley: Draft modal copy idea: Primary: 'Enable autoscaling for this pool?' Body: 'Autoscale will adjust instances between 1 and 8 based on traffic. Estimated cost change: ~+$120/mo. You can change limits later.' Confirm button: 'Enable autoscale' \u2014 Cancel: default 'Keep current settings' Priya: I like that. Small nit: avoid currency in copy if we can't guarantee estimate accuracy. Maybe say 'Estimated monthly cost may increase' and link to a cost estimator. Lyn (a11y-bot): Accessibility notes: ensure the tooltip is keyboard accessible (focusable) and announced by screen readers. Use aria-describedby pointing to the helper paragraph in the modal. Example snippet: ```
Autoscale adjusts instance count to traffic. May affect monthly spend.
``` Also ensure color isn't the only indicator for state (include text 'On'/'Off'). Jon: Localization heads-up: the phrase 'Estimated monthly cost' needs a translatable token. We'll need to pass variables for min/max and estimate. Use key: `autoscale.confirm.body` with interpolation for `min`, `max`, `estimate_link`. Riley: UX decision: do we show a projected cost range inline or force user to open the estimator? I lean to a short sentence + link to estimator so we don't surface stale numbers. Priya: OK update suggestion for modal body: "Autoscale will adjust instances between {min} and {max} based on traffic. This may affect monthly costs. See cost estimator for details." Riley: Sounds good. Also change CTA aria-labels: `enable-autoscale` -> `enable-autoscale-for-pool` to be more descriptive in screen reader lists. Lyn (a11y-bot): Remember focus management: when modal opens, move focus to the modal heading and trap focus. On confirm, return focus to the toggle and announce state change ("Autoscale enabled"). Jon: Telemetry: use event `autoscale_toggle_confirmed_v1` with props {pool_id, min, max, variant} so we can track conversions after copy changes. Riley: Action items: Priya 1 edit tooltip + modal copy and add aria attributes; Jon 1 add telemetry + i18n keys; Lyn 1 verify keyboard/voiceover flow in the PR. I'll attach a tiny mock in the thread. :sparkles: Priya: I'll put up a PR this afternoon. Thanks team!
